items.title: Sensex, Nifty surge in early trade amid lower crude prices: See major gainers and laggards
items.description: The Indian stock market surged in early trade on the first daty of the week. A few minutes after trading began, Sensex 30 was trading at 72,347.16, up 0.61% or 437.45 points while Nifty 50 was at 22,536.95, up 0.51% or 115.00 points. The major Asian share indices were in the green this morning including GIFT Nifty and Nikkei 225.
